10.2.10.5 DemExternalCSDataElementClass
[ECUC_Dem_00668] Definition of EcucParamConfContainerDef DemExternalCS-
DataElementClass ⌈
Container Name
DemExternalCSDataElementClass
Parent Container
DemDataElementClass
Description
This container contains the configuration (parameters) for an external client/server
based data element class.
It defines, how the Dem can obtain the value of the data element from either a SW-C or
another BSW module. Whether a client/server port or a C function-call is used, is
defined by DemDataElementUsePort.
